title: Rainfall-associated richness gains accompany species-selective reassembly of active frog communities
description: Reproducibility package for a Journal of Animal Ecology Research Article testing whether rainfall-associated richness gains in frog acoustic communities reflect uniform activation or species-selective short-term reassembly. The archive contains the anonymized scientific manuscript, frozen analysis contracts, result receipts, deterministic figure-generation code and analysis scripts. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed.
